surface.publish.scope: The active Turn capability selects the only publishable Surface. A caller cannot supply surfaceId or any other scope override.
surface.publish.operationKey: Required nonblank string; reuse it for an uncertain retry and choose a new key for a new publication.
surface.publish.result: The durable surface.revision.published Runtime Event reference.

boundary: The Agent creates Surface and Orchestration authoring directories using ordinary file capabilities. authoring.sync validates and admits these facts. surface.run is an explicit external request whose DSH adapter selects or resumes a Session and starts a Turn. This execution policy does not belong to the Surface content or orchestration core. surface.publish publishes the active Turn's working files before coordination reads them; it is independent of the Turn Brief's business outputs. runtime.recover reports unresolved work; publication and business acceptance remain separate events.
